review.content_class_rationale: Mixed ZIP of four members: a slide deck about this case (Slide set.pptx) and three short transoesophageal echocardiography videos (Video 1.mp4 to Video 3.mp4). One content class cannot describe both, so the row is classed other with archive_mixed modality.

ownership_evidence.quote: A fully edited slide set detailing this case and suitable for local presentation is available online as Supplementary data.
see supplementary material online, Videos S1–S3

estimated_counts.basis: Four members listed in the ZIP central directory and opened from the extracted copy

review.notes: Opened all four members. The deck has 60 text units and nine embedded images (branding graphics, a portable chest radiograph, two echocardiogram figures and a CT slice); the three videos are 0.88 to 0.89 s echocardiography clips (one 2D plus colour-flow, two three-dimensional renderings). The deck carries patient clinical data absent from the article (blood gas, haematology, biochemistry, ECG) and some values that conflict with it (room-air oxygen saturation, INR target and presenting INR, location of embolised fragments); the content review sidecar records these as uncertain and unresolved.
limitations: Video members were reviewed as frames sampled every 0.1 s (8 to 9 frames per clip), every sampled frame viewed; frames between samples, continuous motion and audio were not reviewed.
Slide deck text was read as extracted units and embedded images were viewed individually; slide layout was not rendered.

Content review is the composite sidecar (dense-supplemental-composite-reference/1) for this ZIP; clinical facts from the deck and the printed video heart rate are recorded there, with conflicting items review_only.
Burned-in device text on the radiograph, echocardiogram and CT images and video frames was seen; no names were identified.
